How many different 4-digit codes can be formed using the digits 1-9 without repetition, if the code must be even?
hard.sol: The last digit must be 2, 4, 6, or 8 (4 choices). The remaining 3 positions are filled from the remaining 8 digits, in order: \( 8\times7\times6=336. \) Total: \( 4\times336=1344. \)
